title: free standing towel stand, hook style
text: free standing towel stand, hook style. After first purchasing one of these that was HUGE and took over my whole bathroom counter in it's arm reach, I chose this one.  Winner.  It's still weighty and functional, but doesn't take such a HUGE footprint in it's arm reach and base.  This was easy to assemble - just screw together a couple of pieces.  It's stylish hook is functional and pretty.  The finish is a brushed chrome/stainless look.  Looks more expensive than it cost.

product_metadata.title: SunnyPoint Heavy Weight Classic Decorative Metal Fingertip Towel Holder Stand for Bathroom, Kitchen, Vanity and Countertops. (Brush Chrome, 13.5" x 5.5" x 5.5" INCH)
